<div class="card-body">
'''The Circle Is Now Complete''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">いよいよ決着をつける時が来た</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワンが同じ位置カード上にいる時に使う。1フォース消費して決闘を行う。ライト・セーバーを持っているジェダイは戦闘値が＋2される。敗者は除外カードとなり、残りのゲームの間、同じ人物を表すカードは配備できなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワン・ケノービは、デス・スターのハンガー・ベイ327付近にてライトセーバーで最期の決闘を行った。「修行半ばで貴様の下を去ったが、今やすべてを極めた。」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Time Has Finally Come to Settle This.

'''Card text:''' Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are at the same site. Use 1 Force to duel. A Jedi with a lightsaber adds 2 to their duel total. The loser is placed out of play, and cards representing the same person cannot deploy for the rest of the game.

'''Lore:''' Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought their final lightsaber duel near Death Star Hangar Bay 327. “I left you before my training was complete, but now I have mastered everything.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title paraphrases the English title as the time to settle the matter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[The Circle Is Now Complete|The Circle Is Now Complete]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R41 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-The-Circle-Is-Now-Complete-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
